authority: User: reassess factual accuracy with new conversation
scope: Fresh inference-only comparison of retained factual-binding parent and rejected broader child; no training, optimizer updates, promotion or historical stop changes.
decoding: Full-vocabulary greedy; at most 32 new tokens; stop only BOS/EOS. Actual prior assistant replies remain in conversation; no gold substitution.

metrics.primary: Primary manually reviews every generated answer for complete grounded factual correctness. Natural sentences accepted; no bonus for merely containing the target string alongside contradictions or unsupported claims. Partial names, wrong location relation or fragments are incorrect. Numeric digits may express the same quantity.
metrics.secondary: Case/punctuation-normalized exact-answer compliance on constrained turns only; EOS endings separately; initial answer, explicit correction and delayed recall separately; fully grounded conversations and sibling pairs separately.

rubric_freeze: Rubric fixed before inference; case-level judgments and reasons recorded after direct review. No test-driven training/selection or threshold changes.
limitations: Primary-authored synthetic bank, not an independent or broad world-knowledge benchmark. Each pair swaps initial/corrected values; halves of styles use different scenarios, so style effects are confounded with scenario differences. Model order is retained then rejected; same user bank but self-generated histories differ.
